skill.name: writingmate-mcp
skill.description: Connect Writingmate's remote MCP server to discover AI models, compare text responses, and generate images or videos. Use it for multi-model tasks and media creation from supported MCP hosts.
skill.summary: Connect an MCP host to Writingmate for model discovery, text comparison, image generation, and video generation.
skill.author: writingmate

security_audit.summary: Most findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, fenced examples, documentation links, and a documented Codex configuration path. Three low-severity findings are confirmed because setup connects an MCP host to Writingmate's remote endpoint, where submitted prompts and generation inputs leave the local environment. No prompt injection, covert command execution, credential exposure, or malicious system access was found.

remediation.issue: Prompts and generation inputs are sent to a third-party remote endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the consent guidance prominent, disclose data handling terms, and require confirmation before sending sensitive or regulated content.

content.user_title: Compare AI Models and Generate Media
content.value_statement: Choosing and testing AI models across separate services takes time. Writingmate connects an MCP host to model discovery, text comparison, image generation, and video generation.
actual_capabilities: Lists AI models available to the authenticated Writingmate account.
Retrieves current metadata for an exact model ID.
Creates text through chat completion and Responses-compatible tools.
Compares multiple models using the same prompt and supported settings.
Generates one image per request with supported size options.
Starts video generations and polls their status until completion or failure.
limitations: Requires a Writingmate account and an MCP host with remote Streamable HTTP support.
Prompts and generation inputs are sent to Writingmate's remote service.
Model availability, pricing, allowances, and supported options can change by account.
Image requests currently support one output, while video generation completes asynchronously.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Text Models
use_cases.description: Run the same task across available models, preserve each response, and compare results using task-specific criteria.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Media
use_cases.description: Generate an image or video from a detailed brief while preserving composition, size, and exclusion requirements.

use_cases.title: Add Multi-Model Tools
use_cases.description: Connect an MCP host to model discovery and generation tools without integrating each provider separately.

prompt_templates.title: Discover Available Models
prompt_templates.prompt: List the text models available to my Writingmate account. Group them by capability and show each exact model ID.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with the current account catalog before selecting a model.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Answers
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare two available text models on this task: [task]. Use the same prompt and settings, then recommend one with brief evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate model responses under consistent conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Detailed Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Find an available image model and create a [size] image of [subject] with [composition]. Preserve these exclusions: [exclusions].
prompt_templates.scenario: Create one visual from a structured production brief.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Multi-Stage Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare three available models for [campaign brief]. Use the strongest result to generate one image, then request approval before starting a video.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate text evaluation and media generation while controlling paid operations.

output_examples.input: Compare two available text models for a concise product announcement.
output: Selected model IDs: example-text-a and example-text-b.
Model A was more concise and followed the requested structure.
Model B provided stronger supporting detail but exceeded the target length.
Recommendation: Model A for the final announcement.

output_examples.input: Create a square product image with a white background and no text.
output_examples.output: Generated one 1024 by 1024 image with the selected image model. The returned asset is ready for review.

output_examples.input: Generate an eight-second landscape video and report its final status.
output_examples.output: Started the video job, retained its generation ID, and polled at reasonable intervals. The final asset is returned after successful completion.

best_practices: Call list_models before selection and use only exact model IDs returned by the server.
Use identical prompts and supported settings when comparing model responses.
Confirm costs and data sensitivity before large batches or regulated content transfers.
anti_patterns: Do not invent model IDs or silently replace a failed model.
Do not claim that text or media was generated without a successful tool result.
Do not expose Developer Keys in prompts, public files, screenshots, or issue reports.

faq.question: What do I need to use this skill?
faq.answer: You need a Writingmate account and an MCP host that supports remote Streamable HTTP servers.

faq.question: How does authentication work?
faq.answer: OAuth is preferred. Hosts without OAuth can use a Writingmate Developer Key stored in secure credential storage or an environment variable.

faq.question: How does the skill choose a model?
faq.answer: It lists models available to your account, checks current metadata when needed, and uses an exact returned model ID.

faq.question: Can I send sensitive information?
faq.answer: Only send secrets, private code, personal data, or regulated data after confirming that transfer to Writingmate is allowed.

faq.question: How many images can one request create?
faq.answer: The server currently accepts one image output per generation request.

faq.question: How are video requests handled?
faq.answer: The skill starts a video job, saves its generation ID, and polls at reasonable intervals until success or failure.
